explanation: The lemma says that the inner product of the constant-1 vector with v in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) is v 0. I searched PiL2.lean and found three related declarations. `PiLp.inner_apply` is what the current proof uses, and it only unfolds the inner product. `EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct` and `EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp` are also unfoldings. `EuclideanSpace.basisFun_inner` states ⟪basisFun ι 𝕜 i, x⟫ = x i. It would apply only after rewriting `toLp 2 (fun _ => 1)` as `basisFun (Fin 1) ℝ 0`. That rewrite is an extra fact needing its own `ext` and `fin_cases` proof, so it does not fit the one-or-two-line limit. I found no Mathlib lemma about the inner product with an all-ones vector in dimension 1.
